title: Excessive nesting: guard pyramids hiding the real logic

body.signal: if/for pyramids three-plus levels deep where early returns would flatten the control flow (e.g. categorize_number's label logic).
body.failure_mode: Cyclomatic complexity and mental load grow with depth; edge cases get missed in the middle levels of the pyramid.
body.detection: Radon cyclomatic complexity plus a max-nesting-depth AST metric; flag functions above project thresholds.
body.fix_strategy: Convert nested conditionals to early-return guard sequences; keep behavior identical under the equivalence gate.
